column3: Close to the Hebrew; “the majestic [trees]” is rendered “the mighty trees,” and “the forest of the vintage (inaccessible forest)” “the thick forest.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the thickets of the Jordan” is rendered “the pride of the Jordan.”
Close to the Hebrew; “shepherd the flock” is rendered “Feed the flock.”
Close to the Hebrew; “those who buy them” is rendered “whose owners.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they will crush the land” is rendered “They shall attack the land.”
Close to the Hebrew; “therefore the afflicted of the flock” is rendered “in particular the poor of the flock,” and the staff names “Favor” and “Union” “Beauty” and “Bonds.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I annihilated” is rendered “I dismissed,” and “my soul was short with them” “My soul loathed them.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Favor” is rendered “Beauty.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the magnificence of the price” is rendered “that princely price.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Union” is rendered “Bonds.”

Close to the Hebrew; “he will not visit those being destroyed” is rendered “will not care for those who are cut off,” and “the one standing firm he will not sustain” “nor feed those that still stand.”
Close to the Hebrew; “my worthless shepherd” is rendered “the worthless shepherd.”
